2.en: And the producers of sparks [when] striking

5.en: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,

6.en: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.

7.en: And indeed, he is to that a witness.

8.en: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.

9.ar: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
9.en: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered

10.en: And that within the breasts is obtained,

11.en: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
